ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones on lateral lobes; solid black central pigmentation expanding from the notch; dense black punctate mottling (blobs) distributed across the left lobe; large yellowish-tan chromatic patch on the inner mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 40 degrees; significant depth relative to horizontal fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; consistent pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge with a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters on white fields; high-intensity white clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical and diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) breaking the white pigmentation on the mid-left lobe; shorter horizontal scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-tan bio-fouling or staining on the right lobe; dense barnacle colonization on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry due to the significant tan/yellow patch on the right lobe compared to the left.
